summary: tokenbrine: session tokens are accepted without a signature check in legacy mode (CVSS 8.2)
details: tokenbrine 4.0.0 to 4.2.2 accepts a session token without checking its signature when legacy mode is on (the `legacy` option of `Verifier`, off by default). A service that runs these versions with legacy mode on lets anyone sign in as any user. With legacy mode off these versions are not affected. Fixed in tokenbrine 4.2.3.

database_specific.note: Invented for the triage-evals test cases. Not a real advisory: it describes no real vulnerability.
